title: 经济学家：当前通胀压力不及2021年
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It was interesting that Fedger was said that the FOMC members didn't think the economy was running too hot Last month's nominal GDP was one of the hottest that we've seen in decades excluding the post-pandemic
segments.zh: 有趣的是，美联储表示FOMC成员认为经济并未过热。上月名义GDP是几十年来最热的之一，除了疫情后

segments.en: sort of I guess unusualness of that balance there if you take a look at that Do you think that it squares with underlying inflation around 2% or do you think the economy is running too hot?
segments.zh: 那种不寻常的平衡，如果你看看的话。你认为这与2%左右的基础通胀相符吗，还是你认为经济过热了？

segments.en: I do agree with the chairman and here's the pandemic inflation comparison is a very good one because the Propagation story is the same here, right? There is a bold demand and supply shock
segments.zh: 我同意主席的观点，这里与疫情通胀的比较很好，因为传导机制相同，对吧？存在强劲的需求和供给冲击

segments.en: There was none of the case in 2021-2022 and now we might be in a similar situation But the amplification is not there. So that's why the chairman said they don't think the economy is running too hot
segments.zh: 2021-2022年没有这种情况，现在我们可能处于类似情况，但没有放大效应。所以主席说他们认为经济并未过热

segments.en: It was running too hot in 2021 and 2022 because the problem then was a bottleneck problem, right?
segments.zh: 2021和2022年经济过热是因为当时的问题是瓶颈问题，对吧？

segments.en: You you have a high demand It's really the constraint supply in 2021-2022. So the amplification was huge
segments.zh: 你有高需求，2021-2022年真正是供给约束。所以放大效应巨大

segments.en: Very high inflation and you know an economy that you know running up today We don't have the same amplification. So we have inflation, but it's not that high
segments.zh: 非常高的通胀，经济过热。今天我们没有同样的放大效应。所以有通胀，但没那么高

segments.en: We have a point three percent extra inflation over the last seven quarters that can be linked to both tariffs and the energy shock
segments.zh: 过去七个季度我们有0.3个百分点的额外通胀，这与关税和能源冲击有关

segments.en: So they are they are also supply shocks, but not like supply constraints to do to the extent that happened during the pandemic inflation
segments.zh: 所以它们也是供给冲击，但不像疫情通胀期间那样是供给约束
